title: Sufi imam: jinn change physical scripture but not memory
summary: Rizwan Virk tells of Sufi imam: jinn change physical scripture but not memory, about since the Quran was written down at Islamic tradition, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there was this one Sufi Imam who claimed that the reason why even after the introduction of writing and writing down the Quran that it's still memorized word for word is that there are these entities out there who don't live in normal space and time the way we do. They can go back and change physical objects but they're not allowed to change our memory

plain: Rizwan Virk, a computer scientist and author who argues that our world may be a kind of simulation, tells of a Sufi imam, a religious teacher from the mystical branch of Islam. According to Virk, the imam said the Quran, Islam's holy book, is still memorized word for word because jinn, spirit beings that live outside normal space and time, can go back and change physical objects like written pages but are not allowed to change human memory. Virk shares it as an old idea that echoes his own view that reality can be edited.
